## What's Changed
* ci: check npm tarball contents on pull requests by @Ivansups in https://github.com/Ivansups/gigachat-agent/pull/1
* ci: publish to npm and create GitHub Release on version tags by @Ivansups in https://github.com/Ivansups/gigachat-agent/pull/2
* chore: release 0.1.1 by @Ivansups in https://github.com/Ivansups/gigachat-agent/pull/3
* fix: publish release tarballs by relative path by @Ivansups in https://github.com/Ivansups/gigachat-agent/pull/4

## New Contributors
* @Ivansups made their first contribution in https://github.com/Ivansups/gigachat-agent/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Ivansups/gigachat-agent/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1

Первый публичный релиз: GigaChat (Сбер) как модель и сабагент в opencode и Claude Code.

- Плагин opencode: `opencode-gigachat`
- MCP-сервер: `gigachat-agent-mcp` (ask, run_agent, continue_session, list_models)
- Автовыбор модели `auto`
- Понятные ошибки: сертификат, недоступный хост, нехватка токенов
- `run_agent` по умолчанию только читает; запись только с `allow_write`

Установка: https://github.com/Ivansups/gigachat-agent#readme

Проверено на macOS. Windows, Codex и Cursor не проверялись.
